subject: Human Evolution
title: Detoxifying Food
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Detoxifying Food.

hook.text: Cassava feeds 800 million people today, but eating it raw releases cyanide. Cooking saves lives.

buildup.text: Many plants produce toxins—alkaloids, tannins, cyanogenic compounds—to deter animals from eating them.

discovery.text: Heat breaks down most plant toxins, turning poisonous species into safe staple foods.

twist.text: Some detox methods are cultural, not obvious: soaking acorns for days leaches out bitter tannins.

climax.text: Cooking and food processing vastly expanded the edible landscape—thousands of new foods became safe.

quiz.question: How did cooking expand the human diet?
options: It broke down plant toxins, making poisonous species safe to eat
